name: Calculating the Sum of the Values in an Array
description: Construct a program that computes the sum of all the values in an array.

comments.content: We define array lst to hold the specified numbers. We initialize the array by separating elements with a comma and enclosing the collection in braces { }.
We need variable total to maintain a running total, which means the sum of the values in the array. Of course, the total should be initialized with 0.

We use a for loop to iterate over the array elements and add each element to the running total. We can do this by using for–each statement that visits each element in the array. This for loop assigns the name x to each of the items in the array in turn, from left to right, and then the statement in the loop body will be executed for each value.

We need to add each value in the array to the running total that is stored in variable total. So, in each iteration, we add the array element that we visited to the variable total and store the result back into the variable total.
The += operator adds the value of variable x to the value of the variable total and the result is stored in the variable total. Thus, this statement is equivalent to the statement total = total + x.
This statement prints to the default standard output stream the sum of all values in the array.
The expression in the argument of the println method returns a string that is obtained by concatenating the given string and value of the variable.
